name: Fort Worth
commonIssues: Fort Worth's mix of historic downtown buildings and sprawling suburban neighborhoods creates varied restoration needs. Trinity River flooding, severe spring thunderstorms with hail, and aging plumbing in older neighborhoods drive most water and mold emergencies. Stockyards-area historic structures need careful preservation-grade restoration.

name: Arlington
commonIssues: Arlington's Entertainment District and stadium-area properties need rapid restoration to minimize event-day disruption. Older neighborhoods near downtown have aging clay pipe sewers prone to backups. Spring hail storms damage roofs across the city.

name: Mansfield
commonIssues: Mansfield's rapid growth has built many homes in the last 15-20 years. Builder-grade roofing and windows are vulnerable to hail damage during spring storms. Foundation issues from expansive clay soil often cause hidden plumbing leaks.

name: Grapevine
commonIssues: Grapevine's historic Main Street district requires preservation-grade restoration techniques. Lake Grapevine waterfront properties face occasional flood damage. The DFW Airport-adjacent area sees hotel and commercial restoration needs.

name: Southlake
commonIssues: Southlake's luxury homes have high-end finishes that require specialty restoration after water damage. Spring hail storms cause expensive roof and skylight damage. Custom HVAC systems and complex plumbing in larger homes mean more potential failure points.

name: Keller
commonIssues: Keller's newer homes face hail and wind damage from severe weather. The community's emphasis on family neighborhoods means insurance-friendly, family-considerate restoration is essential.

name: Bedford
commonIssues: Bedford's housing stock from the 1970s-90s often has aging plumbing and original water heaters. Mid-cities location means heavy spring storm exposure and frequent hail damage claims.

name: Euless
commonIssues: Euless's proximity to DFW Airport brings constant noise that can mask early water leak signs. Older homes have aging cast iron sewer lines that fail and back up. Spring weather brings predictable hail and wind damage.

name: Hurst
commonIssues: Hurst's 1960s-80s housing stock often has cast iron and galvanized plumbing past its expected lifespan. Aging HVAC systems and water heaters lead to leaks and mold issues.

name: North Richland Hills
commonIssues: North Richland Hills has many homes from the 1960s-90s with aging plumbing and HVAC systems. Spring storms bring hail damage to roofs. Foundation movement from North Texas clay soil often triggers slab leaks.
